digest.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
digest.tldr: By his own admission, David Robinson is “something of a cliché”: an employee at a leading AI company who issues a dire warning while resigning from their job.

digest.title: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm
digest.tldr: David Robinson used to write the safety reports that accompanied every major model release at OpenAI.  This week, he resigned from his position and is now speaking out in an editorial in The Atlantic.

digest.title: Heading Home: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-12 Concludes Station Science Mission
digest.tldr: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-12 mission is ending, with the crew scheduled to return in early October.

digest.title: NASA’s DAVINCI Probe Can Stand the Heat
